description: Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode. Pass stop:true to end the loop.
name: ScheduleWakeup

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600].

noop.description: true if nothing changed; false if something happened worth keeping.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately.
